blocks.prompt: 12 If \(z_1 = 4 + 5i\) and \(z_2 = \alpha - 2i\), find the value of \(\alpha\) such that \(\operatorname{Re}(z_1 z_2) = 20\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 4 jaisa sawal hai, lekin is dafa shart (condition) product ke real part par hai.
\(\operatorname{Re}(z_1 z_2)\) product ka woh hissa hai jis ke saath \(i\) nahi laga.
Diya kya hai? \(z_1 = 4 + 5i\), \(z_2 = \alpha - 2i\), aur \(\alpha\) ek unknown real number hai.
Plan: dono ko multiply karenge, real aur imaginary terms alag karenge, real part ko 20 ke barabar rakh kar \(\alpha\) nikalenge. Imaginary part kuch bhi aaye, us ki koi shart nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(z_1 = 4 + 5i\), \(z_2 = \alpha - 2i\), \(\alpha\) real, \(\operatorname{Re}(z_1 z_2) = 20\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\alpha\).
Tareeqa: Dono numbers multiply kar ke product ko (real part) + (imaginary part)\(i\) shakal mein likhenge. Real part \(\alpha\) ki ek linear equation dega, jisay 20 ke barabar rakh kar solve karenge.

\(z_1\) aur \(z_2\) multiply karein
\[z_1 z_2 = (4 + 5i)(\alpha - 2i)\]
\[= 4\alpha - 8i + 5\alpha i - 10i^2\]
\[= (4\alpha + 10) + (5\alpha - 8)i\]
Kyun: Term by term: \(4\alpha\), \(4(-2i) = -8i\), \(5i \cdot \alpha = 5\alpha i\), \(5i(-2i) = -10i^2 = +10\). \(+10\) real hai, is liye \(4\alpha\) ke saath real part mein gaya; \(i\) wale terms \(-8i + 5\alpha i = (5\alpha - 8)i\).
Dhyan dein: Bachche aksar \(-10i^2\) ko imaginary part mein daal dete hain. \(i^2\) real number \(-1\) hai, is liye yeh term real hai.

Real part ko 20 ke barabar rakhein
\[4\alpha + 10 = 20\]
\[4\alpha = 10\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{10}{4} = \dfrac{5}{2}\]
Kyun: Real part woh term hai jis ke saath \(i\) nahi, yani \(4\alpha + 10\). Isay 20 ke barabar rakha, 10 doosri taraf le gaye: \(4\alpha = 10\), phir 4 se divide kar ke chhota kiya: \(\alpha = \frac{5}{2}\).

Tasdeeq
\[z_2 = \dfrac{5}{2} - 2i\]
\[z_1 z_2 = 20 + \dfrac{9}{2}i\]
\[\operatorname{Re}(z_1 z_2) = 20 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = \frac{5}{2}\) rakhne par real part \(4 \cdot \frac{5}{2} + 10 = 10 + 10 = 20\) aur imaginary part \(5 \cdot \frac{5}{2} - 8 = \frac{25}{2} - \frac{16}{2} = \frac{9}{2}\). Real part bilkul 20 hai, jaisa chahiye tha.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\alpha = \frac{5}{2}\)
Yani \(z_2 = \frac{5}{2} - 2i\) lene se product ka real part theek 20 banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(\alpha = \frac{5}{2}\) number 11 ke saamne likha hai, jab ke yeh asal mein Question 12 ka jawab hai. Question 11 (i) aur (ii) ka jawab key mein diya hi nahi gaya; un ke sahi jawab upar poore hal ke saath diye gaye hain.
